content.rendered:
Fevic Water Mug – Outer PP, Inner Stainless Steel with Suction Base

Bring convenience and safety to your daily hydration with the Fevic Water Mug, thoughtfully designed for home, office, and travel use. Featuring a durable polypropylene (PP) outer shell combined with a stainless steel inner lining, this mug offers both strength and a clean, hygienic drinking surface.

Its standout feature is the innovative suction base with a lightly visible orange ring, engineered to grip flat surfaces and prevent accidental tipping or spills. Simply place it on your desk or table and enjoy stable, worry-free use — yet it lifts straight up effortlessly when you’re ready to take a sip.

Make spills and accidental tipping a thing of the past with the Fevic Water Mug, a smart blend of safety, durability, and style. Designed for modern workspaces, homes, and travel, this mug features a tough polypropylene (PP) outer body and a hygienic stainless steel inner lining. The combination gives you a lightweight, impact-resistant exterior with a clean, food-grade interior that keeps beverages tasting fresh.

The Fevic Water Mug is designed to combine style, safety, and practicality in one premium drinkware solution. Its outer shell is crafted from high-quality Polypropylene (PP), offering a modern, sleek look that resists scratches and is easy to clean. Inside, the stainless steel lining ensures beverages remain fresh and hygienic, with no lingering flavors or odors. This dual-layer construction also helps maintain your drink’s temperature for longer, making it equally suited to hot or cold beverages.

A standout feature of this mug is its innovative suction base. With a subtle orange accent ring, the base creates a strong grip on flat surfaces, dramatically reducing the risk of accidental tipping or spills — perfect for busy desks, kitchen counters, or travel scenarios. Simply lift it vertically to release the suction easily.

The Fevic Water Mug is ergonomically designed for comfort, lightweight enough to carry anywhere, and durable enough for daily use. Its sophisticated finish and unique base design make it an ideal corporate gift or festive premium, especially during occasions like Diwali. When customized with your company logo or a special message, it becomes not just a mug but a memorable keepsake that promotes your brand while being genuinely useful to the recipient.

Whether used at home, in the office, or on the go, the Fevic Water Mug stands out as a thoughtful, functional, and stylish gift that combines innovation with everyday convenience.
